metaDesc: The 7 closest hotels to Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Suvarnabhumi, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for layover, early-flight and late-arrival travellers.
ogDesc: The 7 closest stays to Suvarnabhumi, with real distances and prices.
intro: Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) sits on Bangkok's eastern edge, straddling Lat Krabang and Racha Thewa (Samut Prakan). Most hotels around it are built for connecting passengers, early departures and late arrivals, so the main selling point is the airport shuttle and round-the-clock check-in. Only one hotel is genuinely inside the airport — the Hyatt Regency (formerly the Novotel); the rest bring you in by shuttle from the surrounding area. Below are places we checked are real and genuinely bookable, with real distances to the terminal and straight talk on each shuttle, ordered cheapest to priciest.

blocks.html: Short answer: For a tight connection or an early-morning flight, the closest hotel is the Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi (formerly the Novotel) right inside the airport — a 5-minute walk through the underground passage to the terminal. Cheaper picks like Sinsuvarn Airport Suite, The Park Nine, Siam Mandarina and Courtyard by Marriott sit in Lat Krabang–Racha Thewa, 5–20 minutes by free shuttle. Most run a 24-hour shuttle, but you usually need to book it ahead and give your flight details.

blocks.text: Hotels near Suvarnabhumi, by distance & budget

items.name: Sinsuvarn Airport Suite
items.meta: 📍 10-min shuttle (6 km) to Suvarnabhumi · ★ 3-star · Best for: Layovers · a few hours' rest · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The cheapest pick in the area, a small hotel on the Lat Krabang side about 6 km from the airport. The free 24-hour shuttle runs on a schedule with limited seats, so call ahead and give your flight time. Rooms are plain but clean, and there's a small pool and a restaurant. Reviewers call it good value for a few hours' sleep before an onward flight — nothing fancy, but it does the job for a connection night.

items.name: Cozy Blu Suvarnabhumi
items.meta: 📍 18-min drive (10 km) to Suvarnabhumi · ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · newer clean rooms · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A newer hotel on the Bang Phli–Lat Krabang side, about 10 km and an 18-minute drive from the airport. One thing to know: the shuttle here is not free — it's a flat fee of around 750 THB per vehicle each way (seats up to 7), which is cheap split between a group but a Grab may work out better for a solo traveller. Rooms are new, roomy and clean, with a free breakfast buffet and a pool, and reviews praise the cleanliness and staff. A good fit if you're on a budget and not too fussed about distance.

items.name: The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi
items.meta: 📍 8-min shuttle (3 km) to Suvarnabhumi · ★ 4-star · Best for: Early flights · good value · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On the Racha Thewa side, about 3 km from the airport and an 8-minute shuttle ride. The free 24-hour shuttle is an 8-seat van with Wi-Fi, but seats are limited so reserve ahead. It scores around 9 out of 10 in reviews, with roomy, clean rooms, a pool and gym, and a solid breakfast. A good pick if you want a comfortable, good-value base before an early flight without paying big-brand prices.

items.name: Best Western Premier Amaranth Suvarnabhumi Airport
items.meta: 📍 20-min shuttle (7 km) to Suvarnabhumi · ★ 4-star · Best for: Late arrivals · larger hotel · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A large 538-room hotel on the Lat Krabang side, about 7 km from the airport and roughly a 20-minute ride. The free two-way shuttle runs hourly, roughly 04:30–01:30, and you must book ahead with full flight details since it's scheduled rather than on-demand. Rooms are standard Best Western Premier, some with a balcony and seating area, plus a pool and restaurant, and reviews praise the breakfast and staff. A good fit for a late arrival who wants a larger hotel with chain consistency.

items.name: Siam Mandarina Hotel
items.meta: 📍 10-min shuttle (5 km) to Suvarnabhumi · ★ 4-star · Best for: Layovers · frequent shuttle · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A popular layover pick on the Lat Krabang side, about 5 km from the airport and a 10-minute ride. The draw is the free 24-hour shuttle that runs frequently; the airport meeting point is Gate 3, 2nd floor, opposite the information counter, and seats are limited per trip so book ahead. It also offers day-use rooms for resting between flights. Rooms are clean, with a pool, gym, café and restaurant. A good fit if you want an easy, frequent shuttle and simple airport access.

items.name: Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport
items.meta: 📍 8-min shuttle (3 km) to Suvarnabhumi · ★ 4-star · Best for: Newer brand · near Lat Krabang ARL · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A newer Marriott-brand hotel on the Lat Krabang side, about 3 km from the airport and an 8-minute ride on the free 24-hour shuttle. It's roughly 4 km from the Lat Krabang Airport Rail Link station, handy if you're heading into the city. Rooms are modern with big-screen TVs and a mini fridge, plus an outdoor pool, a 24-hour gym and a spa. A good fit if you want a fresh, well-run brand close to the airport that still connects to the train into town.

items.name: Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk inside the airport to Suvarnabhumi · ★ 5-star · Best for: Tight connections · staying airside-close · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The only hotel inside Suvarnabhumi itself — formerly the Novotel, rebranded to Hyatt Regency in February 2025. It connects to the terminal via an air-conditioned underground passage on the B1 level, about a 5-minute walk, or you can take the free 24-hour shuttle from Gate 4, Arrival Level. It has 610 rooms, a garden pool, a spa, a gym and several restaurants. It's the priciest on this list, but for a tight connection or a very early flight, being a walk from the terminal is worth the premium.

faq.q: Which hotel is closest to Suvarnabhumi, within walking distance?
faq.a: The Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi (formerly the Novotel) is the only hotel inside the airport, a roughly 5-minute walk to the terminal through an air-conditioned underground passage on the B1 level. It's ideal for a tight connection or a pre-dawn departure when you don't want to risk waiting for a shuttle. Every other hotel sits in the surrounding area and needs a shuttle in.

faq.q: Is the airport shuttle really free, and do I need to book it ahead?
faq.a: Most are genuinely free and run 24 hours — Sinsuvarn, The Park Nine, Siam Mandarina, Courtyard by Marriott and the Hyatt Regency among them — but nearly all have limited seats and run on a schedule, so reserve ahead and give your flight number and time. Amaranth runs hourly, roughly 04:30–01:30, and needs a booking with full flight details. The exception is Cozy Blu, whose shuttle is not free — about 750 THB per vehicle each way.

faq.q: I have a late arrival or short layover — where's a cheap, clean place to sleep near the airport?
faq.a: For something cheap and clean for a few hours, Sinsuvarn Airport Suite starts around 950 THB, sits about 6 km out and runs a free 24-hour shuttle. Siam Mandarina also offers day-use rooms so you can rest during the day without paying for a full night. If your connection is genuinely tight and you don't want to risk it, paying more to sleep at the in-airport Hyatt Regency removes the shuttle from the equation entirely.
